opening.argument: The presenter introduces a roundup of major news, and the on-screen banner identifies it as a collection of Bihar headlines. The coverage ranges from COVID-19 figures and a scheduled train service to political developments and other district and public-service updates, with IIT Patna placements among the topics discussed. The presenter also asks viewers to assess a political leader's tenure, an invitation to share an opinion on current affairs. These headlines, statistics and summaries function as reporting and discussion. Nothing in the described material asks viewers for money or account credentials, or invites them to participate in an investment or similar transaction.

citations.quote: Let's get into today's big news
The number of corona-affected people in Bihar has reached over 2 lakhs.
The train scheduled for the No. 02849 Rachi Patna Festival Special train will be ready on November 18.
According to you, is Chief Minister Nitish Kumar a successful leader in his 5 years of work or not?
